You will join a highly skilled maintenance team where safety, quality and continuous improvement are key priorities. This position is based in Geleen, one of the largest industrial and petrochemical hubs in the Netherlands. Your responsibilities Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on instrumentation and electrical systems. Calibrate pressure, temperature, flow and level transmitters. Troubleshoot electrical and instrumentation faults. Install and commission new field instrumentation. Read and interpret P&IDs, loop drawings and electrical schematics. Assist during plant shutdowns and turnarounds. Ensure all work complies with safety regulations and quality standards. Contribute to improving plant reliability and equipment performance. Employment conditions At Xelvin, we do much more than help you find a job. We help you build a future in the Netherlands. You can expect: A salary between €3,800 and €4,700 gross per month Full-time employment with long-term career opportunities Overtime and shift allowances where applicable 25 vacation days plus holiday allowance Pension scheme Extensive training and development opportunities Personal guidance throughout your career Complete relocation support Moving to another country is a big step. That's why Xelvin supports you throughout the entire relocation process. Our relocation package includes: Work visa and residence permit support Assistance with finding suitable accommodation Flight to the Netherlands Airport pick-up Municipal registration (BSN)Opening a Dutch bank account Health insurance guidance Dutch language lessons Ongoing support from your dedicated Xelvin Consultant Job requirements We are looking for motivated professionals who are ready to take the next step in their international career. You have: A recognised trade qualification in Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I), Instrumentation or Electrical Engineering. Experience as an Instrumentation Technician or E&I Technician. Experience within the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical or Chemical industry. Knowledge of process instrumentation, control valves and field devices. Experience reading P&IDs and electrical drawings. Good English communication skills. Afrikaans language skills (preferred). A proactive attitude and willingness to relocate to the Netherlands. Preferably between 23 and 28 years old, making this an excellent opportunity for early-career professionals looking to build an international career. Every year we help engineers and technicians from South Africa relocate successfully to the Netherlands, where they build long-term careers with international employers. Take your technical expertise across Europe Are you an experienced Field Service Engineer with a strong mechanical background and a passion for solving complex technical problems? For an international manufacturer of advanced packaging machinery, Xelvin is looking for a Field Service Engineer who will support customers within the food and beverage industry. You will install, maintain and improve high-quality packaging machines at customer locations across Europe. This position offers a high level of independence, international travel and the opportunity to develop into a technical specialist within a global organisation. The preferred location for this position is the south of the Netherlands, such as North Brabant or Limburg, or the north of Belgium, including East Flanders, Antwerp or Limburg. What will you be doing? As a Field Service Engineer, you will be the technical point of contact for customers. You will ensure that their packaging machines operate safely, reliably and efficiently. Your responsibilities will include: Performing professional service, maintenance and repairs on existing packaging machines. Installing, assembling and commissioning new machines at customer locations. Diagnosing and resolving mechanical, electrical and automation-related malfunctions. Carrying out machine modifications, upgrades and conversions. Providing both on-site and remote technical support. Performing preventive maintenance to reduce downtime and improve machine availability. Monitoring machine performance and identifying potential technical issues at an early stage. Advising customers and sharing technical expertise to solve operational problems. Training customer employees in the correct operation and maintenance of the machinery. Preparing accurate service, quality and installation reports. Maintaining clear communication with customers and the Field Service Manager. Identifying possible commercial opportunities or risks during customer visits. Working closely with aexperienced and internationally oriented Field Service team. Most assignments will take place in the Benelux and Scandinavia. Depending on customer demand, you may also support customers in other parts of Europe. What can you expect from Xelvin? A gross monthly salary between €4,200 and €5,200, depending on your knowledge and experience. A company car, including private use. Paid overtime and 25 annual leave days. Training and career development opportunities. A complete relocation package when required, including a relocation budget, housing support, assistance with the 30% ruling, and support with arranging your BSN, bank account and health insurance. What do we expect from you? You are a practical and customer-focused engineer who enjoys working independently in an international service environment. You bring: At least five years of relevant experience as a Field Service Engineer, Mechatronics Engineer or Service Technician. Strong mechanical knowledge, as approximately 60% of the position is mechanically focused. Good electrical and automation knowledge, representing approximately 40% of the role. Experience with industrial machinery, production equipment or packaging machines. Experience with troubleshooting, commissioning and preventive maintenance. Knowledge of Siemens S7 and TIA Portal is an advantage. Knowledge of Bosch Rexroth servo systems is an advantage. Good written and spoken English. A valid driving licence. The willingness to travel regularly throughout the Benelux, Scandinavia and other parts of Europe. Availability to travel up to approximately 75% of your working time by car or aeroplane.
